name: so-corporate-income-tax
description: Somalia ordinary corporation income-tax working paper for 2026 preparation from the enacted Income Tax Act 37 of 2025. Use for company profit reconciliation, statutory deduction limits, losses, tax-base decisions and return preparation. It identifies the corporation rate, accrual accounting, the overall business-deduction ceiling, capital expenditure and the difference between book profit and taxable income. Two executable examples compute an ordinary profit and the deduction-ceiling decision. Taxpayer classification, effective implementation, specialist sectors, cross-border outcomes and live form and payment instructions remain explicit gates. It replaces unsupported legacy company scales while preserving predecessor topics in a destination ledger and the platform attribution and contact block. It provides a conditional statutory baseline, not a completed filing, current-law assurance or licensed accountant attestation.
